name: Jeff Bergman
bio: Jeffrey Allen Bergman (born July 10, 1960) is an American voice actor. He has provided voices for numerous classic animated characters, most notably for Looney Tunes and Hanna-Barbera, starting in the late 1980s. Bergman replaced Mel Blanc as the voice of Bugs Bunny and several other characters following Blanc's death in 1989.
